scopes.account_settings:read: View account settings. Includes account configuration, ticket and user fields, and workspaces.
scopes.account_settings:write: Create, edit, and delete account settings. Includes account configuration, ticket and user fields, and workspaces.
scopes.any_channel:write: Push messages from an external channel into Zendesk. Includes creating tickets, comments, and users from an integrated channel. Write only.
scopes.apps:read: View installed apps and their settings. Includes a list of installed apps and each app's settings.
scopes.apps:write: Install, configure, and remove apps. Includes installing and uninstalling apps, changing settings, and uploading custom app packages.
scopes.auditlogs:read: View audit logs, which provide an account-wide record of who changed what and when.
scopes.brands:read: View brands and their agent assignments.
scopes.brands:write: Create, edit, and delete brands and their agent assignments.
scopes.custom_objects:read: View custom objects. Includes custom object definitions and record attachments.
scopes.custom_objects:write: Create, edit, and delete custom objects. Includes definitions and record attachments.
scopes.deletion_schedules:read: View deletion schedules. Includes data retention policies that automatically delete tickets, users, and other data.
scopes.deletion_schedules:write: Delete deletion schedules. Includes deleting data retention policies.
scopes.dynamic_content:read: View dynamic content items and language variants.
scopes.dynamic_content:write: Create, edit, and delete dynamic content items and language variants.
scopes.groups:write: Create, edit, and delete groups and their memberships.
scopes.hc:read: View Help Center content. Includes articles, sections, categories, community posts and comments.
scopes.hc:write: Create, edit, and delete Help Center content. Includes articles, sections, categories, community posts and comments.
scopes.impersonate: Allows Zendesk Support admins to make requests on behalf of end users. See [Making API requests on behalf of end users](/documentation/ticketing/using-the-zendesk-api/making-api-requests-on-behalf-of-end-users/).
scopes.macros:read: View macros, their categories, and attachments.
scopes.macros:write: Create, edit, and delete macros and their attachments.
scopes.organizations:read: View organizations and their details. Includes memberships, subscriptions, and merge history.
scopes.organizations:write: Create, edit, and delete organizations and manage their memberships. Includes adding and removing users, managing subscriptions, and merging organizations.
scopes.read: Read all data. Gives access to GET endpoints, including permission to sideload related resources.
scopes.requests:read: View support requests and their comments.
scopes.requests:write: Submit and edit support requests. Includes creating new requests and adding comments to existing ones.
scopes.satisfaction_ratings:read: View satisfaction ratings, scores, and reasons.
scopes.satisfaction_ratings:write: Submit satisfaction ratings. Includes rating a ticket as good or bad with an optional reason.
scopes.security:read: View security and sign-in settings. Includes password policies, session timeouts, IP restrictions, and SSO configuration. Read only.
scopes.sla_policies:read: View SLA and group SLA policies.
scopes.sla_policies:write: Create, edit, delete, and reorder SLA and group SLA policies.
scopes.targets:read: View targets and their delivery failures.
scopes.themes:read: View Guide themes and their files.
scopes.themes:write: Create, edit, and delete Guide themes. Includes importing, updating, publishing, exporting, and deleting themes.
scopes.ticket_attachments:write: Upload, edit, and delete ticket attachments. Includes uploading files, updating and deleting attachments, and redacting them.
scopes.ticket_views:read: View ticket views and the tickets they return.
scopes.ticket_views:write: Create, edit, and delete ticket views.
scopes.tickets:read: View tickets. Includes ticket contents, comments and conversation history, tags, forms and fields, audits, events, and metrics.
scopes.tickets:write: Create, edit, and delete tickets. Includes adding comments, tags, merging tickets, marking spam, attachments, forms, and custom statuses.
scopes.triggers:read: View triggers, trigger categories, and their revision history.
scopes.triggers:write: Create, edit, delete, and reorder triggers and trigger categories.
scopes.users:read: View users. Includes identities, active sessions, group, organization, and brand memberships, roles, and settings.
scopes.users:write: Create, edit, and delete users and manage their access. Includes resetting passwords, ending sessions, adding identities, changing memberships, and managing custom roles.
scopes.web_widget:write: Edit Web Widget settings and configuration. Write only.
scopes.webhooks:read: View webhooks and their activity history.
scopes.webhooks:write: Create, edit, test, and delete webhooks.
scopes.write: Write all data. Gives access to POST, PUT, and DELETE endpoints.
scopes.zis:read: View private integrations. Includes configurations, connections, and inbound webhooks.
scopes.zis:write: Create, edit, and delete private integrations. Includes configurations, connections, and inbound webhooks.
